note: Troup County Parks & Recreation campground in 458-acre Pyne Road Park on West Point Lake, 5 mi from LaGrange (campground entrance 100 Osprey Cir; park 4481 Roanoke Rd). Primitive and electric sites for tents and RVs. Mega-Ramp boat launch with an attendant, nature trails; the park's Oakfuskee Conservation Center is an event venue. --Claude
summary: Troup County's Pyne Road page (trouprec.org, captured 2026-06-13; the domain now redirects to the county's parks index, which has no campground page): 22 tent/RV sites, primitive $25 / electric $30, 14-day max, seasonal (Visit LaGrange: March-November). Fees were unset - now 25-30. Pin is ~470 m north of the campground, on the entrance road. Hookups (water), flush toilets and dump left as stored (no current page confirms or denies them). Note trimmed of the RV Life line and field repeats.
flags: Pin ~470 m off: stored 33.0289,-85.1533 sits on the park entrance road in forest. The campground loop (RVs visible on imagery) and Google's point for the campground address 100 Osprey Cir are at about 33.0247,-85.1532.

Website: http://www.trouprec.org/Facilities/Pyne_Road (and every trouprec.org page) now 301-redirects to https://www.troupcountyga.gov/departments/parks_recreation/index.php, where Pyne Road Park is listed under 'All Facilities' with no page of its own; the second website line is the Visit LaGrange tourism page. No current county page for the campground exists - the latest is the trouprec.org page archived 2026-06-13.
